title: A novel nanocatalyst praseodymium oxide (Pr6O11) for the efficient and sustainable synthesis of chromene derivatives via ultrasound irradiation in an aqueous hydrotropic medium
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25985-25999
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03100A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sarika Patil, Nilesh Pandit, Avdhut Kadam, Suraj Attar, Chaitali Bagade, Dattaprasad Pore, Santosh Kamble
Ultrasound-assisted synthesis of chromene derivatives using Pr6O11 as a catalyst in 20% NaPTS as a hydrotrope offers a green, efficient, and sustainable method with enhanced reaction rates and low energy use under mild conditions.
